decisions.reason: As a 2018 launch that builds directly on the established airfield-control offering, was publicly promoted as a new industry standard, and fits the firm's announced move toward integrated automated airport operations, management is very unlikely to withdraw it absent clear failure evidence.

Because this surveillance display extends the firm's existing portfolio and supports its integrated real-time information strategy in a growing market, management would tend to continue backing it, though with slightly less commitment than Product A because the public launch signal was weaker.
